notes: Accuracy: 2/25 wrong (Vava Eyewear not on the cited Silmo page, which now shows only 2026 winners; DITTO not in the cited Wikipedia category). The other 23 are named on their source pages. Layer problem: 12 of the 25 are labelled premium only because they appear on a retailer A-Z list (Markenkoffer: 9) or an optician directory with paid listings (Optician Now, non-bold entries). Markenkoffer's own page calls Travelite the pick 'for budget-conscious travellers'. Treat Markenkoffer, Optician Now (non-bold), Luxe Digital and Wikipedia category listings as name-existence evidence only, not quality evidence: retag them cultural/unverified or re-source them. SYSTEMATIC SRC ERROR: about 19 harvested names (Carmen Steffens, Alexander Daas, Epiphany Eyewear, Flying Eyes Optics, Revant Optics, Serengeti Eyewear, Shred Optics, Bluesmart, G.W. Scott and Sons, Kennebunk Manufacturing Company, Sljeme, Blue Elephant, DITTO, Solstice Sunglasses, Belen Echandia, English Retreads, Flowfold, Harveys SeatbeltBags, House of Harlow) cite https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Category:Leather_manufacturers but are not on that page. They come from other Wikipedia categories (Sunglasses/Eyewear brands, Luggage manufacturers, Fashion accessory brands), so each needs its true category URL. The Silmo src also needs dated per-year pages. Additions: 62 brands and 7 regions, all on raw-fetched pages. They fill these gaps: baby carriers (the harvest had almost none: Didymos, Oscha, Girasol, LennyLamb, Storchenwiege, Natibaby, Kinderpack, Artipoppe); Korean and Chinese handbags (OSOI, Samo Ondoh, Marhen.J, Songmont, Qiuzhen, Grotto, Duanmu); Indian luggage icons (Safari, Skybags, Aristocrat, Carlton, Mokobara); Kerala umbrellas (Popy, John's); French EPV umbrella and fan makers; wagasa and oil-paper umbrellas (Guang Jin Sheng, Bo Sang; Hiyoshiya was already known); sports and running sunglasses (Goodr, Tifosi, Roka, SunGod etc.), which the harvest had at 0; Chinese domestic eyewear; MENA (Okhtein, Sarah's Bag); Africa (Zaaf, Adele Dejak); Central Asia (Tumar, which was 0); Oceania bilum; Ukraine, Greece and Colombia. Thin-area retries: Southern Europe (Ubrique and Greece found), Western Europe Germany (Offenbach, Comtesse), Central Asia (Tumar), Oceania (bilum), East Asia Korea/China/Taiwan (found), SE Asia (Exsport, NaRaYa, Bo Sang), South Asia (Indian luggage and umbrellas; Pakistan/Bangladesh still nothing usable), sports sunglasses (found). Still blind: reading glasses (Forbes test page blocked; Peepers, ThinOptics, Izipizi not attested), folding and clip-on sunglasses, garment and dry bags, Caribbean, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Finland eyewear, Russia, Turkey, Brazil (only Serpui's own page, not added), Mexico (Vogue MX page empty), Maori kete makers, antique eyewear makers.
